summary.text: Liz Barbour is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 35 who took office in December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A small business owner, she developed The Positively Hollis project, a web-based news platform and quarterly newspaper.

paragraphs.text: Liz Barbour earned a bachelor's degree from Syracuse University.
Her career experience includes working as a small business owner and developer of The Positively Hollis project, a web-based news platform and a quarterly newspaper.
Barbour assumed office in the New Hampshire House on December 4, 2024.
She advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the general election ballot for Hillsborough 35.
